stem.text: Separate samples of magnesium and calcium are added to an excess of dilute sulfuric acid. The observations are summarised in the table.

rows:
vigorous reaction, bubbles of gas produced,
magnesium completely dissolves

vigorous reaction initially, bubbles of gas produced,
reaction soon stops and leaves most of the calcium unreacted

stem.text: Which statement explains the difference in these observations?

A.text: Calcium is a better oxidising agent than magnesium.

B.text: Calcium is a better reducing agent than magnesium.

C.text: Magnesium is a more reactive metal with all dilute acids than calcium.

D.text: Magnesium sulfate is more soluble than calcium sulfate.
